definitions.explanation: a person who tends to feel embarrassed or self-conscious easily

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{恥|は}ずかしがりで{人前|ひとまえ}で{話|はな}すのが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: He's shy and doesn't like speaking in front of people.

examples.japanese: {恥|は}ずかしがりな{性格|せいかく}を{克服|こくふく}したい。
examples.english: I want to overcome my shy personality.

examples.japanese: うちの{子|こ}は{恥|は}ずかしがりで、{初対面|しょたいめん}の{人|ひと}と{話|はな}せない。
examples.english: My child is shy and can't talk to people they meet for the first time.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
{恥|は}ずかしい (embarrassed/shy) + がり (tendency suffix)

VARIATIONS:
- {恥|は}ずかしがり - shy person (noun)
- {恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や} - shy person (with {屋|や} suffix, slightly more endearing)
- {恥|は}ずかしがりな - shy (na-adjective form)

USAGE:
Can function as a noun or as a na-adjective modifier:
- {恥|は}ずかしがりな{子|こ} - a shy child
- {恥|は}ずかしがりだ - is shy

SIMILAR PERSONALITY TYPES:
- {照|て}れ{屋|や} - easily embarrassed person
- {内気|うちき} - introverted, timid
- {引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん} - reserved, reticent

RELATED ～がり COMPOUNDS:
- {寂|さび}しがり - person who easily gets lonely
- {怖|こわ}がり - timid/easily scared person
